# verda startup-script

> Verda CLI **v1.10.0** · [other versions](https://github.com/verda-cloud/verda-cli/tags)

Manage startup scripts

Create, list, and delete startup scripts that run when a VM boots.

Subcommands:

- [`verda startup-script add`](#verda-startup-script-add): Add a startup script
- [`verda startup-script delete`](#verda-startup-script-delete): Delete a startup script
- [`verda startup-script list`](#verda-startup-script-list): List startup scripts

## verda startup-script add

Add a startup script

Add a new startup script to your account. In interactive mode you will
be prompted for the script name and then asked to load from a file or
paste the content. Use flags for non-interactive use.

**Usage**

```text
verda startup-script add [flags]
```

**Flags**

```text
      --file string     Path to a script file
      --name string     Script name
      --script string   Inline script content
```

**Examples**

```bash
# Interactive
verda startup-script add

# From file
verda startup-script add --name setup --file ./init.sh

# Inline script
verda startup-script add --name setup --script "#!/bin/bash\napt update"
```

## verda startup-script delete

Delete a startup script

Delete a startup script from your account. In interactive mode you
will be prompted to select a script and confirm deletion. Pass the
script id as an argument or with --id for non-interactive use. Agent
mode requires an id and --yes.

**Usage**

```text
verda startup-script delete [<id>] [flags]
```

Aliases: `rm`

**Flags**

```text
      --id string   Startup script ID to delete (alternative to the positional argument)
      --yes         Skip confirmation for destructive actions (required in agent mode)
```

**Examples**

```bash
# Interactive
verda startup-script delete

# Non-interactive
verda startup-script delete abc-123
verda startup-script delete --id abc-123

# Agent mode
verda --agent startup-script delete abc-123 --yes
```

## verda startup-script list

List startup scripts

List all startup scripts in your account, showing Name, ID, and CreatedAt.

**Usage**

```text
verda startup-script list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`

**Examples**

```bash
verda startup-script list
verda script ls
```

---

Global flags such as `--output`, `--agent` and `--debug` work with every command: see [Global Flags](../commands.md#global-flags).
